entities.name: Aryl methyl ether demethylation
observations: Reactant COc1cc2c(cc1C(=O)c1cc(C(C)(C)C)c(O)c(C(C)(C)C)c1)CCC2 converts to product CC(C)(C)c1cc(C(=O)c2cc3c(cc2O)CCC3)cc(C(C)(C)C)c1O by cleavage of Ar–O–CH3 to Ar–OH.
The ketone, pre-existing phenolic OH, tert-butyl groups, and tetralin skeleton remain unchanged.
Exact core-reactant match supports selective Lewis-acidic aryl methyl ether cleavage rather than hydrogenation, oxidation, or rearrangement.

entities.name: Boron tribromide
observations: BBr3 is the directly documented demethylating reagent for this exact transformation.

entities.name: BBr3 in dichloromethane
observations: Documented reagent set includes boron tribromide in dichloromethane; ethanol is listed for quench/workup.
